description: This file defines the controller class AOS_ContractsController for handling edit view actions related to AOS_Contracts within the SuiteCRM project. It manages data retrieval and setting values for contract editing, including related quotes, accounts, contacts, and opportunities.

classes.name: AOS_ContractsController
classes.description: Controller class extending SugarController to handle contract editing views, including loading related quote, account, contact, and opportunity data.

methods.name: action_editview
methods.description: Handles the logic for preparing the 'edit' view for AOS_Contracts, fetching related data for quote, account, contact, and opportunity, and setting appropriate bean properties.
